description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter named DocumentsListAdapter for displaying a list of Document entities in an Android application. It manages selection states, inflates item views, and binds Document data (such as title, creation date, and preview image) to UI components.

classes.name: DocumentsListAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView ListAdapter for displaying Document items with selection capability.

classes.name: DocumentsListAdapter.DocumentVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for binding Document data to item view components.

classes.name: DocumentsListAdapter.Diff
classes.description: DiffUtil.ItemCallback implementation for efficient list updates.

methods.name: getSelected
methods.description: Returns a list of currently selected Document objects.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new DocumentVH view holder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a Document item to the view holder.

methods.name: DocumentVH.bind
methods.description: Binds a Document's data to the UI components within the view holder.
